structure.description: Each row represents one country, with GDP-per-capita measurements stored in year-labeled columns.
The GDP-per-capita columns form a chronologically ordered wide time series from their year suffixes.

uncertainties: The monetary currency, inflation adjustment, purchasing-power basis, and source methodology are not specified.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the country and year-bearing column labels visible in train.csv.
